title: Easy Cheesy Capsicum Pizzas
subtitle: with Caramelised Onion Topping
description: Whether you’re full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they’re packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they’re totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Remove the pizza dough from the fridge and bring to room temperature (the dough will increase in size). Preheat the oven to 230C, fan-forced. Put a large oven tray in the oven to heat. Thinly slice the capsicum and onion. Combine half the barbecue seasoning and 1 tsp olive oil in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the capsicum and toss to coat.

Prep pizza base: Remove the dough from the packet, lightly knead and shape into a ball. Dust the dough with plain flour and put on a large piece of lightly floured baking paper. Using a rolling pin or your hands, roll or stretch the dough into a thin rectangle (if the dough starts to shrink back, set aside to rest for 1-2 mins before rolling again).

Assemble and bake pizza: Combine 2 tbs tomato paste and 1 tsp olive oil in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Spread the tomato mixture over the pizza base, leaving a 1cm border. Scatter over the capsicum and cheese. Carefully remove the hot tray from the oven. Using the baking paper, slide the pizza onto the tray. Bake for 16-18 mins until golden.

Caramelise onion: Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp olive oil in a small frypan over medium heat. Cook the onion, stirring, for 3-4 mins until softened. Add 2 tsp sugar and 2 tsp balsamic vinegar and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins or until the onion is caramelised. Add the remaining barbecue seasoning and cook for 30 secs or until fragrant. Remove the pan from the heat.

Serve up: Cut the tomato into thin wedges. Combine 2 tsp olive oil and 2 tsp balsamic vinegar in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the spinach and tomato and gently toss to coat. Cut the pizza into squares. Divide among plates and top with the caramelised onion. Serve with the salad and enjoy!
Make it yours: Finish the pizza with a drizzle of your favourite mayo for extra creaminess and flavour. If your mayo is too thick to drizzle, stir through a dash of water for a thinner consistency.
